Plugin.Name: Unraid Secretary Office
Plugin.Overview: A small office inside Unraid's web UI: a staff of secretaries, each looking after one part of your server. Mr. Backupsy runs a nightly backup (consistent ZFS/btrfs snapshots, database dumps, Nextcloud maintenance mode, VMs held or shut down for the seconds of the snapshot, a package per app and VM, optional encrypted offsite copies with Kopia — new things stay local until you decide). Mr. Restori brings apps, databases, VMs and folders back from those packages, snapshots or Kopia — everything he replaces is put aside first, never deleted. Ms. Snapshotini manages ZFS, btrfs and VM snapshots with schedules and retention. Ms. Protocolli reads the logs. The Night Watchman keeps a watch book of what changed from normal (logins, containers, plugins, the flash, schedules, data flow, vanished snapshots) and says how secure the server stands. Ms. Dustdevil knows what lies where, gives operational advice, clears away what nobody uses (without deleting at once) and fills in missing container icons. Jack Emby moves what you watch next onto a fast pool (EmbyCache) and keeps film folders together. The Consultant checks the tools the office relies on and installs them with you (Kopia, Fix Common Problems, Prometheus, Grafana). The Team Lead hires the staff your server needs, tells you what is left to do and reports to Unraid's notifications. Speaks English, German, Italian, French and Spanish. No account, no licence, nothing locked.
Plugin.DonateText: Tips keep the office going — a share goes to helmi1987, who wrote Jack Emby's tools, and what goes beyond our costs to animal shelters.
